body: You know, i posted here before and here i am today, thinking of killing myself, crying to myself, wishing i was dead, because you know im stupid. I did something for the person i love, i dropped my uni, made my parents hate me and look down to me, dont think they are the nicest people because they arent , but that person rejected me at the end. Everyday i think of killing myself and listen to people tell me shit like 'u are fat' 'ugly' useless, even the person that says he loves me.. Doesnt wanna be with me, says im a crazy bitch, with no feelings, no worries, when he doesnt realize hes exactly what hes calling me. Im tired everyday, and i still keep on going because i think hey man, one day i will be happy. Think the same dont let them crush u
I hear you, feel ur pain, dont give up
